supporting_pages.title: "Detect anomalies in multiple time series with the TimesFM model \_|\_ BigQuery\
evidence_snippets: Go to BigQuery In the query editor, paste in the following query and click Run , the query takes 1-2 minutes to complete: WITH bike share trips AS ( SELECT TIMESTAMP TRUNC ( start date , HOUR ) AS trip hour , COUNT ( ) AS num trips FROM bigquery-public-data.san francisco bikeshare.bikeshare trips GROUP BY TIMESTAMP TRUNC ( start date , HOUR ) ) SELECT FROM AI .

Go to BigQuery In the query editor, paste in the following query and click Run : WITH bike share trips AS ( SELECT TIMESTAMP TRUNC ( start date , HOUR ) AS trip hour , COUNT ( ) AS num trips , subscriber type FROM bigquery-public-data.san francisco bikeshare.bikeshare trips GROUP BY TIMESTAMP TRUNC ( start date , HOUR ), subscriber type ) SELECT FROM AI .
